assets.name: clarity-organizer
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium 3D cutout illustration for Subloom, a calm subscription organizer. A compact matte forest-green desk organizer tray holding three neatly arranged warm ivory paper subscription cards with subtle embossed horizontal lines, one small ivory date tile with a forest-green checkmark, and two modest brushed gold coins at its base. Communicate getting recurring expenses organized and feeling in control. Soft tactile paper and satin ceramic, restrained rounded edges, sophisticated financial editorial illustration, orthographic three-quarter view, upper-left studio lighting, very soft contact shadows with native alpha. Palette strictly forest #182D25, green #087C65, mint #E1F0DE, warm ivory and restrained gold. Centered square composition, whole objects visible, generous transparent margin on every side. Genuine transparent background. No purple, blue, pink, candy plastic, humans, plants, text, numbers, logos, branding, scene backdrop, gradient background or pedestal.
